notes.title: This Is Not A New Updates!
notes.content:
Hey huskies,

New updates arrives!

[b]This dose not include[/b]
- New graphics
- New Old TV visual effect
- Bug fix
- Lovely husky

Welcome to the not weird game ever!

notes.title: This Is Not A Lunar Dog Year Notice Awwwwwww
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Happy Lunar New Dog Year!

In the Dog Year, "This Is Not A Jumping Game" will be officially released!
Discount, sale is coming!!!

After lots of suggestion from EA players, I've improved game experience a lot.
Here is the update info:
1. Change the order of some levels, since some similar levels are put together and it's kind of boring.
2. Replace some meaningless levels, and add new gameplay levels called "Portal". 
P.S. I really like The "Portal" series of Valve, so here it is. lol
3. Improve the collision detection of Husky, to make the collision more reasonable, especially with the spikes.
4. Lower the difficulty of some action kind levels, since the difficulty is somehow not necessary.
5. Adjust the Entry of hidden levels. Come on guys, you can figure them out when come to Game Week Two.
6. Add Hint system. If you are stuck in the level, it will help you get through!
7. Lunar Spring Festival, the Covers have been changed since they are much more joyful! 
8. New language Japanese added.

--------------Dog Year Fever!!-----------------

notes.title: This Is Not Another Update Notice
notes.content:
Hi, Husky lovers!

Husky thanks everyone who fed him a lot! 

This is the 2nd important Update Notice, so please put aside your bones and pay attention:
1. Game graphics are improved! Various styles of maps in every 20 levels!
2. Adjust the difficult of some levels!
3. Fixed some problems in some levels.
4. Awuuuuuuuuuu!!

notes.title: This is Not a update notice
notes.content:
Hi, guys!

Husky thanks everyone who fed him a lot! Thank you for supporting this not a jumping game!

This is the first Update Notice, so please put aside your bones and pay attention:
1. Since the BGM is quite brainwashing but too few, I've added some BGM in the levels and level-select Interface. Besides, I've added a special BGM to Level 100(the final level). EnjoyAwwwuuu!
2. Fixed some small problems in levels, although it's not important to gameplay...fixed them anywayAwwwuuu!
3. Fixed some animation problems. Husky doesn't like wrong animationAwwwuuuu!
4. Improve some performance of effects.
5. Fixed the gamepad problem in some special levels.
6. Husky are happy when more and more players feed him well! Awwwuuu!!
